criteria.name: Fallback‑to‑filesystem description
criteria.evidence: docs/design/mcp-cards.md:36-40 "If the repo manifest sets `cards.transport: mcp` ... helper issues an MCP `resources/read` ... writes to /tmp/... and prints that path. If the manifest is unset ... or the MCP call fails ... the helper falls back to the existing `stage_card_for_id` lookup and prints the on-disk path. The fallback is not optional."
